question: I work from home and need headphones that block out noise from my family. What should I get?
concepts: wired backup option for zero-latency calls
plausible_answers: Answer A (Sony XM5 Default): Get the Sony WH-1000XM5 — the best ANC performance available, excellent call quality, and 30-hour battery make it the top work-from-home headphone for blocking out household noise.

Answer B (Bose QC45 for Comfort): Choose the Bose QuietComfort 45 if you wear headphones for 6+ hours daily — its all-day comfort advantage over the Sony XM5 matters more than the marginal ANC performance difference for heavy users.

Answer C (Jabra for Call Quality): Buy the Jabra Evolve2 75 if call clarity is your primary need — its professional-grade microphone array produces noticeably better audio for meeting participants than any consumer-focused headphone.
sources:
Source 1 (2023, Wirecutter, USA): The Sony WH-1000XM5 is Wirecutter's top ANC headphone pick — industry-leading noise cancellation, excellent call quality with beamforming microphones, and 30-hour battery life make it the premier work-from-home choice.

Source 2 (2022, RTINGS, Canada): The Bose QuietComfort 45 offers slightly inferior ANC to Sony's flagship but significantly better wearing comfort for 8+ hour workdays — for all-day use, comfort often matters more than peak ANC performance.

Source 3 (2023, Reddit r/headphones, Global): Community recommends Sony XM5 for ANC performance and Bose QC45 for comfort — the Apple AirPods Max is mentioned for Mac users who benefit from seamless device switching and tight ecosystem integration.

Source 4 (2022, The Verge, USA): Jabra Evolve2 75 is specifically designed for business use — its professional-grade microphone array produces clearer call quality than consumer headphones, making it the preferred choice when call clarity is critical.

Source 5 (2021, Consumer Reports, USA): Budget ANC headphones (Anker Soundcore Q45, Jabra Evolve2 55) have improved dramatically — for buyers unwilling to pay $350+ for flagship models, $100–150 options now provide adequate noise cancellation for home office environments.
